AccessRule.description:
What locks a module or an item: every condition must hold. A rule on a module also locks the
items and sub-modules in it. At most 10 conditions; none removes the rule.

user_ids.description:
1 to 1000 user ids. All or nothing: one bad entry rejects the request, and the `422`
names its position as `user_ids[i]`.

added.description: The users who were not members before. Empty when all of them already were.

AdminCourse.description: A course of the institution as the administrator lists it.

AdminInstitution.description:
What an admin sees: the public profile and the settings that are not public. Read-only; they
change in the config file (ADR-0044).

AllStudents.description: The only value of the `students` selector that is not a list.

Announcement.description: Something a teacher told the course. Plain text.

AppDownload.description: Where one installer of the institution's desktop app can be downloaded.

AppExchangeRequest.description: The app trades the handoff and its secret for a session (ADR-0062).

verifier.description: The secret whose SHA-256 the app gave to `start`, 32 to 128 characters.

AppLoginResponse.description: Response to a login with `client = app`.

AppPlatform.description: A kind of installer of the desktop app (ADR-0064): the systems of ADR-0063's installers.

Assignment.description: The assignment part of an item of kind `assignment` (ADR-0021).

accept_late.description: Whether work is taken after `due_at`; set exactly when `due_at` is.

class_on.description:
The day an in-class (`no_submission`) assignment takes place, `YYYY-MM-DD` (ADR-0049);
`null` for any other type.

config.description:
Settings of the type; an empty object for `no_submission`, the editor narrowing for `text`,
the questions for a `quiz` (ADR-0050), the fields for a `form` (ADR-0051) and
`{max_files?, accept?}` for a `file` (ADR-0069). A student
never receives the answer key of a quiz. A form's fields carry the read-only facts
`has_answers` and, on the options of an exclusive field, `taken` and `taken_by`.

due_at.description:
The deadline (ADR-0035). `null` when there is none, and always `null` for a type that takes
no submissions.

is_bonus.description: Extra credit: outside the sum that the `hundred` grading scale limits (ADR-0022).

late_until.description: The end of the late window; `null` means never. Only with `accept_late: true`.

max_attempts.description: The most attempts a student may submit; `null` means no limit.

max_points.description: A decimal string with exactly two decimals, e.g. `"20.00"`.

oneOf.description: What happens to a draft at `due_at`; set exactly when `due_at` is.

type.description: The assignment type: `text`, `no_submission`, `quiz`, `form` or `file`. It cannot change.

AssignmentSummary.description: What the course tree shows of an assignment: everything but `config`.

max_points.description: A decimal string with exactly two decimals, e.g. `"20.00"`.

Attempt.description: One submitted attempt. Attempts are numbered from 1 per student and assignment and never change.

auto_scores.description:
Staff only, for a `quiz`: the score of each question that was scored by the server, as
decimal strings (ADR-0050). A `long_text` question has none.

is_late.description: True when it was submitted after `due_at`, inside the late window.

AttemptsPage.description: A page of the attempts of one student, newest first (staff).

AuditKind.description: What an audit entry is about, derived from its action.

AuditRecord.description: One row of the audit log.

oneOf.description: `null` for a row the server CLI wrote.

meta.description: Ids, roles and field names only.

resource_label.description: What the target is called now; `null` when it is gone.

AuditSource.description: Where an audit row was written.

Block.description:
One block. `id` is 1 to 64 characters from `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`, unique in the document and
generated by the client. `props`, `content` and `children` are left out when empty.

oneOf.description: A LaTeX formula on its own line.
A Mermaid diagram.
An uploaded image (ADR-0069). Allowed in every profile.
A card for an uploaded file (ADR-0069). Allowed in the profiles `full` and `student`.

Candidate.description: Someone who could be added to the course.

Candidates.description: At most 20, best order first. Not paged.

CardNext.description: The next piece of work a student has to do.

CardProgress.description: A student's numbers over the assignments of a course that take submissions.

CardRole.description: The caller's place in a course.

CardTodo.description: One thing a teacher has to do in a course. Entries with a count of 0 are left out.

oneOf.description: Submitted work with no draft score.
Draft grades that are not published; `auto_scored` when they come from quizzes.
Draft items inside published modules; at most three titles.
The next deadline of the course.

language.description: A language outside the list is stored as `text`.

source.description: Plain text; the client highlights it.

Condition.description:
One condition of a rule.

`completed` names an item (`item_id`) or a module (`module_id`), not both. An assignment is done
when the student has submitted it or has a published score; a text or file item, when the
student marks it (`PUT /items/{id}/completion`); a module, when it has items the student can see
and all of them are done.

`score_at_least` names an assignment (`item_id`) and `points`, a decimal string above 0, at most
what the assignment is worth.

ContentModule.description:
A top-level module with its sub-modules and its direct items. Both lists are in position
order; clients show sub-modules first.

ContentTree.description: The whole content of a course as the caller may see it. Not paged: a course tree is bounded.

term_id.description: The term the course belongs to, if any (ADR-0032).

CourseCard.description: One course of the caller on the course list and the home page.

oneOf.description: Students only.
Students only.

term_ended.description: The term's last day is before today in the institution's time zone.

CourseCards.description: The course cards of the caller.

CourseGroupLink.description: A live link of a course to a whole group, or to one subgroup of it.

subgroup_id.description: Set when only this subgroup is linked; `null` links the whole group.

CourseInfo.description: The header of every course screen. A read model: nothing here is stored as it is shown.

code.description: The short code, e.g. `CS 305`; empty when none is set.

content_updated_at.description: When a module or item last changed; `null` for a course with no content.

former_count.description: People who left the roster but have results in the course (ADR-0037).

graded_items.description: How many assignments that sum counts.

has_grades.description: A grade has a value in the course, so it cannot be deleted, only archived.

owner_email.description: The owner is the person to ask, so everyone who can view the course gets this address.

student_count.description: Current students: on the roster and active.

term_name.description: The name of the course's term; `null` without a term.

total_points.description: The sum of `max_points` of the regular assignments the caller may see.

updated_at.description: When the course row (title, term, code, description, status, owner) last changed.

CourseLine.description: A course as a line of a list.

CourseRef.description: A course, as a line of the teacher's overview.

CourseRole.description: A user's role inside one course. The owner is a `teacher` flagged `is_owner`.

CreateAnnouncementRequest.description: Publishes an announcement to the course at once.

term_id.description: An existing term; an unknown one is a `422` on this field.

CreateFromTemplateRequest.description: Makes a draft course from a template.

term_id.description: An existing term; an unknown one is a `422` on this field.

title.description: The new course's title; the template's own when absent.

oneOf.description: Required for `kind: assignment`, not allowed for the other kinds.

description. For a `file` item it is `{file_id?, description?}` and defaults to `{}`: the file
is uploaded (`POST /files?for=item:{id}`) once the item exists and named with
`PATCH /items/{id}`. It is read as a JSON value so that a rejection can name the path.

`text`, `assignment` or `file`. Omit it to get `assignment` when an `assignment` object is
sent and `text` otherwise.

parent_id.description: A top-level module of this course, to create a sub-module. Omit for a top-level module.

temporary_password.description: Shown once. The user must change it at first login.

CreatedGradebookGroup.description: The key of a new group.

not_open.description: The assignment is a draft: students do not see it yet.

Deadline.description: An assignment due from now on.

Document.description: A block document. `attachments` must be empty for now and is optional on input.

DocumentLimits.description: The numeric limits a document is validated against.

EditorProfile.description: One profile as the server enforces it.

features.description: The features this profile allows after the institution's config narrowed it.

single_block.description: True when a document of this profile is exactly one block, without children.

EditorProfiles.description: What the editor needs to build its toolbar: the effective profiles and video providers.

video_providers.description: The providers a video block may name; empty when video is switched off.

Exclusion.description: A person taken off the roster of one course although a linked group would put them on it.

Feature.description: What a place of the editor can offer. A profile is a set of features (ADR-0025).

FieldError.description: One rejected field of a `422` response.

file_id.description: A file uploaded for the owner of this document; the server checks that it may be used.

FileRefDto.description: A stored file, as a document or a submission names it by `id`.

mime.description: The content type found from the bytes, not the one the client claimed.

name.description: The cleaned file name: no path, at most 200 characters.

FormResponseRow.description: The answers of one student to a form: their latest attempt (ADR-0051 point 7).

answers.description: Field id to the answer, as stored.

FormResponses.description: All the responses to a form.

total_students.description: The current students of the course.

GoogleCallbackRequest.description: What Google sent back to the web app's callback page.

GoogleCallbackResponse.description: A sign-in with Google ends with a web session, or, when a native app started it, with a handoff.

GoogleHandoffResponse.description: The end of a native app's sign-in with Google (ADR-0062): a code for the app, good once for a minute.

app_challenge.description:
From a native app (ADR-0062): the SHA-256 of a secret the app keeps, as 64 lowercase hex characters.
The attempt is then tied to the app, not to a browser, and ends in a `handoff` for the app.

login_hint.description: An address to pre-fill on Google's page.

GoogleStartResponse.description: Where to send the browser for Google's consent screen.

GradeCell.description: One cell as staff see it: both slots. Never sent to a student.

draft_score.description: A decimal string with exactly two decimals, or `null`.

has_unpublished_changes.description: True when the draft differs from the published value.

GradeHistoryEntry.description: One recorded change of a grade (ADR-0049). Data, not a sentence: the client words it.

oneOf.description: `null` when no person made the change.

feedback.description: The feedback after the change; `null` when none.

score.description: The score after the change, a decimal string with two decimals; `null` when none.

assignment_id.description:
The column this cell belongs to: the `assignment_id` of an entry of `columns`. Clients
build a map from it; the cells of a row are not padded to match `columns`.

GradebookCell.description:
The grade of one student in one column. A cell exists only where a grade row exists: the
student was graded in that column at least once (a draft saved, even one that was cleared).

GradebookColumn.description: A gradebook column: one assignment of the course, in course tree order.

group.description:
The `key` of the group the assignment is counted in (ADR-0089); `null` when it is in none
("Not sorted"). Absent from a twelve-point installation, which has no groups.

max_points.description: A decimal string with exactly two decimals, e.g. `"20.00"`.

status.description: The item's status, so staff can tell a draft column from a published one.

GradebookGroup.description: A group of assignments and its rules (ADR-0089).

best_k.description: Only the best K marks count; `null` = all of them.

bonus.description: True = extra: adds to the total, not to what a student can still reach.

cap.description: The most the group adds to the total, a decimal string; `null` = no cap.

counts.description: False = practice: graded and shown, not part of the total.

key.description: The top-level module's id in the `course` layout, the group's own id in the `custom` one.

GradebookGroupInput.description:
The rules of a group, and its title when it is one of the teacher's own. A `PUT` replaces the
rules, so every key has its default when absent.

assignments.description: Only when creating: assignments to put in the new group, at most 500.

bonus.description: True = extra. Default false; a practice group cannot be bonus.

cap.description: The most the group adds to the total, a decimal string above 0; `null` = no cap.

title.description: 1 to 200 characters; required to create a group, refused for a module's group.

GradebookGroupResult.description: What one group of one student adds up to, for the staff table.

dropped.description: Assignments left out by the "best K" rule.

key.description: The group's `key`; `null` for the assignments that are in no group.

GradebookLayout.description: Where a course's groups come from (ADR-0089).

GradebookLayoutView.description: How a course turns points into a result, the same for every student (ADR-0089).

groups.description: The groups in the order they are shown.

GradebookOutcome.description: What one student's marks add up to.

earned.description:
Every point earned, before the target cuts it (116 when the target is 100); the same as
`total` when it is not more than the target.

passed.description: `null` when the course has no pass mark.

total.description: The final total, never more than the target; a decimal string with two decimals.

GradebookPage.description:
A page of the staff gradebook, paged by student (ADR-0018). `columns` is the same on every
page; each row's `cells` refer to a column by `assignment_id`.

oneOf.description:
The settings, the groups and the setup status, the same on every page (ADR-0089); absent
on the twelve-point scale.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

GradebookPlacement.description: Puts assignments in a group of the teacher's own, or in none.

assignments.description: At most 500, each once, all assignments of the course.

group.description: A group's key; `null` puts them back in "Not sorted".

GradebookRow.description: One student of the gradebook with their cells.

cells.description:
Only the cells that exist, in column order, each carrying its `assignment_id`. A column
with no cell here means this student has no grade there: absence is "no grade", not an
error and not a cell with empty values.

former.description:
Not on the roster now (left the group, disabled, promoted, excluded) but has grades in the
course. A former student's grades are kept and read-only: a write answers `409` and
"publish all" skips them (ADR-0037).

oneOf.description: What this student's marks add up to (ADR-0089); absent on the twelve-point scale.

pass_mark.description: The mark that passes, a decimal string from 0 to the target; `null` or absent = none.

target.description: The points that make a full result, a decimal string above 0, at most 9999; usually `"100"`.

GradebookSetup.description: What is left to do before the gradebook is in order.

empty_groups.description: Keys of the groups that have no assignment.

possible.description: What a student can reach, bonus left out; a decimal string with two decimals.

reaches_target.description: What a student can reach is at least the target.

unsorted.description: Assignments in no group, in the `custom` layout.

GradebookStructure.description: Everything the Structure mode shows (ADR-0089). Staff and admins.

columns.description: Every assignment of the course in tree order, each with its group.

groups.description:
In the `custom` layout every group, empty ones included; in `course` the modules that have
an assignment.

suggestions.description: Only in the `custom` layout, only for assignments in no group.

GradebookSuggestion.description: A proposed group: assignments whose titles share a stem.

GradebookTotals.description: A student's total from the published slots, and from the drafts. Staff only.

GradingScale.description: How points relate to the grade (ADR-0022).

Group.description: A cohort: school class 7-A, university group PZ-31.

GroupMember.description: A member of a group or a subgroup.

added_at.description: `null` for those who were in the group before the time was recorded.

GroupOption.description: A group a course can be linked to, with its subgroups. Ids and names only: no members.

GroupOverview.description: A group, its people and the courses that use it.

modules.description: The optional modules compiled into the server, enabled or not.

version.description: The release of the server binary. `vumlo-cli doctor` compares it with its own.

HitStatus.description: Whether a hit is visible to students.

alt.description: At most 300 characters of plain text.

caption.description: At most 300 characters of plain text.

file_id.description: A file uploaded for the owner of this document; the server checks that it may be used.

href.description: http or https, at most 2048 characters.

oneOf.description: A formula inside a line, as LaTeX.

Institution.description: The public profile of the institution: what a page needs before anyone signs in (ADR-0044).

app_downloads.description:
The links to the desktop app's installers, in the order platforms are listed above. Empty: the
institution has no app to offer (ADR-0064).

short_name.description: For narrow places such as the navbar.

InstitutionMode.description: What kind of institution the installation serves (ADR-0031).

Item.description:
A `text` item, an assignment or a `file` item. `body` is a JSON object; for an assignment it holds
the instructions, for a `file` item `{file_id?, description?}`: the uploaded file (absent while
the item is a draft without one) and a document that describes it.

oneOf.description: Staff only (ADR-0092): the rule that locks the item. Absent when it has none.
Present for items of kind `assignment`, absent for `text` items.

body.description:
A block document (ADR-0025) for a `text` item and an assignment, `{file_id?, description?}`
for a `file` item. The server returns the stored body as is.

oneOf.description:
Students only (ADR-0092): where they stand. While `standing.locked` is not empty, `body` is
empty and so is the assignment's `config`.

ItemMeta.description:
The facts of one item that the course tree does not carry. Only the facts that apply to the
item and to the caller are present.

class_on.description: In-class assignments: the day they take place.

draft_grades.description: Staff: grades whose draft differs from what is published.

edited.description: Staff: the item is published and has changes students do not see yet.

graded_total.description: Staff: current students of the course.

read_minutes.description: Lectures: minutes to read the body the caller sees, at least 1.

score.description: Students: the published score; absent until grades are published.

oneOf.description: Students, assignments: the caller's own standing.

submitted.description: Staff, assignments: current students who submitted at least once.

to_grade.description: Staff: of those, the ones without a score yet.

ItemMetaMap.description: The facts by item id, for the items the caller may see.

ItemRevision.description: What the editor shows about the unpublished changes of an item.

has_unpublished_changes.description: The working title or body differs from what students read.

last_published_at.description: When students last got a new version; `null` for an item never published.

size_bytes.description: The size of the working body as JSON.

ItemSummary.description: An item in the course tree: everything but the body.

oneOf.description: Staff only (ADR-0092): the rule that locks the item. Absent when it has none.

Language.description: The interface language an institution starts in (ADR-0043).

LatestAttempt.description: The latest submitted attempt of a student, without its content.

Launch.description:
A token for the plugin's own server, valid for a minute. It says who looks at which assignment, in
the course's terms (`student` or `staff`), and is signed with the plugin's secret (ADR-0066).

LaunchRequest.description: Asks for the token a plugin page uses to learn who is looking and at what.

subgroup_id.description: A subgroup of `group_id`; absent or `null` links the whole group.

LinkRun.description: What a link may contain: text only.

LinkedCourse.description: A course that uses a group, or one of its subgroups.

LinkedGroup.description: A group or subgroup linked to the course. Staff only.

student_count.description: Current students the link brings (active, not excluded).

subgroup_name.description: Set when the link is to one subgroup.

MailAudience.description: Which people of a course a plugin's mail is for.

MailTarget.description: Who a plugin's mail is for: one person, or a course audience.

oneOf.description: One person, who must be on the roster of a course the plugin reaches.

title.description: The template's title; the course's own when absent.

MemberSource.description: Where a roster entry comes from: a membership written on the course, or a linked group.

Membership.description: One member of a course. Only ids: names and emails are fetched through the user endpoints.

source.description:

linked group or subgroup (ADR-0033).

modules.description: Enabled modules, each after the ones it requires.

none.

position.description: Starts at 1, among the siblings with the same parent. Gaps are possible.

publish_at.description: Students see the module only from this moment on.

earned.description:

passed.description: `null` when the course has no pass mark.

total.description: The final total, never more than the target.

The published grades of the caller in one course, in course tree order. Not paged: a course
is bounded (ADR-0020).

MySubmission.description:
The caller's own work on an assignment: the draft, if there is one, and the attempts, newest

subgroup.

The day an in-class assignment takes place, `YYYY-MM-DD` (ADR-0049). Only for
`no_submission`.

config.description:
Settings of the type, a JSON object. Defaults to `{}`; `no_submission` has none, a `quiz`
needs its questions (ADR-0050), a `form` its fields (ADR-0051) and a `file`

due_at.description:

late_until.description:

max_attempts.description: At least 1; omit for unlimited attempts.

on_deadline.description: `keep_draft` or `auto_submit` (the latter takes effect with the background worker).

post.description:
`body` is a JSON object that is stored and returned as is; an array or a string is rejected.
For an assignment it holds the instructions. `kind` is optional: without it the item is an
assignment when an `assignment` object is sent and a `text` item otherwise.

A `file` item has the body `{file_id?, description?}` (`description` is a document). It starts
without a file: upload one with `POST /files?for=item:{id}` and name it with
`PATCH /items/{id}`. `file_id` must be a file the caller uploaded that nothing uses yet. A
`file` item must not carry an `assignment` object.

`kind: assignment` requires an `assignment` object `{type, config?, max_points, is_bonus?}`
(ADR-0021); a `text` item must not carry one. `type` is `text`, `no_submission`, `quiz`, `form` or `file`; the
`config` of a `quiz` is its questions and must add up to `max_points` (ADR-0050), that of a `form` its
fields (ADR-0051), that of a `file` `{max_files?, accept?}` (ADR-0069), and the others take an empty one (a `text` assignment may narrow its editor).
`max_points` is a decimal string such as `"20"` or `"7.5"`; a JSON number is rejected. The
grading scale limits the points (ADR-0022): at most 12 per assignment on `twelve`, at most
100 in total over the regular (not bonus) assignments of the course on `hundred`.
